searchText: Hey guys, as promised, here is the writeup of the current merge sync idea: https://github.com/fjl/p2p-drafts/blob/master/merge-sync/merge-sync.md will link it in the allcoredevs agenda, thanks <@!194432762315407360> ! Nice! This is generally how I've been thinking about it too Seems like the core issue to work through and/or find a technical compromise on is deep reorgs during times of no finality (something not *too* difficult on the beacon chain, but much more unwieldy with the large application state) I also have some ideas about how to do most of your sync strategy with the existing defined rpc methods. Maybe with an added enum on engine_validate. Can discuss tmw I'm kind of happy I didn't use the real API for now. It's much easier to change it around when it's not tied to anything existing. We will definitely change it for the reorg thing.
